Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Business Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIM Kozhikode Business Executive positions is 06 September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Business Executive post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Business Executive post in the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Business Executive role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-Graduation or MBA in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute to be eligible for the Business Executive position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Business Executive post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Business Executive position is 40 years. No minimum age limit is specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Business Executive position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Business Executive post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,300/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIM Kozhikode Business Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview conducted via video conference.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Kozhikode located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode is located in Kozhikode, Kerala, with the pincode 673570.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with relevant experience apply?
faq.answer: Yes, relevant experience is a key requirement. Candidates need either five years of experience with a salary of Rs. 35,000/- or above, or ten years of experience with a salary of Rs. 25,500/- or above.
